integrity: This package contains an analytic argument, numerical reproducibility checks and a qualified bibliographic review. It makes no claim of independent mathematical validation or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The geometric polytope has dimension d at least two and cant strictly between zero and ell. Limits hold at fixed ell as dimension increases; fixed-moment convergence is analytic, but finite Monte Carlo checks are only corroboration. Novelty may be affected by equivalent previously published formulations under general zonotope terminology.
title: Skew-normal width fluctuations and a sharp fluctuation-minimizing cant for isocanted cubes
